'''Valry Redeye''' was an aged [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] who specialized in [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] trafficking during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="raid">{{WEGCite|story=Slave Raid|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
==Biography==
Valry reached an age where he could no longer be a [[hunting/Legends|hunter]], the main cultural trait of Rodians. Instead he decided he could "hunt" for information which he could sell. He retreated to [[Vergesso Base]], a [[shadowpoert/Legends|shadowport]] in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]]. He was aware that [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]], the real owners of the base, were secretly using it for slave transfer as well, a common secret among infochants about which nobody dared to talk about.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref><ref name="raid" />

One time, in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> a group of beings came to the base. One acquaintance had been captured by [[slaver/Legends|slavers]] and they knew they were heading for Bajic, which had no major slave market. The fact that some visitors were poking around for slave trade reached Tenloss, and some [[mercenary/Legends|thugs]] were sent to make clear they were asking wrong things in the wrong place.<ref name="raid" />

Eventually they reached Valry; although he knew that anyone talking about slave trade on Vergesso could end up dead, he was willing to talk for an amount of 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. A few [[standard hour/Legends|hours later, he returned to them, and directed them to [[Docking Bay 762]].<ref name="raid" />

==Personality and traits==
He was so named because he was fitted with a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="raid" />
